content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: This Guidance Note provides advice on how to:
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: assess the economic and financial standing (EFS) of bidders during a procurement
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: monitor the ongoing EFS of suppliers during the life of a contract
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: mitigate the financial risks identified from the EFS evaluation of a bidder, either upfront or during the course of the contract.
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: Assessing and monitoring the EFS of suppliers is about understanding the financial capacity of suppliers to perform a contract in order to safeguard the delivery of public services.
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: Make sure you:
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: read the Guidance Note and relevant Commercial Playbook
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers

content_blocks.text: seek legal and commercial advice in the context of specific procurements.
heading_path: Assessing and monitoring the economic and financial standing of suppliers
